verdict.rationale: Docs show ByteAsk supports bringing any OpenAI-compatible model and connecting to multiple providers (OpenRouter, Groq, Together, DeepSeek, Mistral, xAI, Cerebras, Fireworks) via `byteask models add`, plus an `auto` mode that chains across multiple models/providers, giving developers explicit choice over which model powers a session. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of provider switching in practice, and clearer per-session UI/CLI flag documentation for selecting a model at invocation time.
